entities.name: Vasily Dolgorukov-Krymsky
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Vasily Mikhailovich Dolgorukov-Krymsky was a Russian statesman, general, and the commander-in-chief of Moscow from 1780 to 1782. Already a seasoned veteran of several wars, he was a senior military commander of the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774, where his forces occupied the Crimean Khanate, from which he derived his honorary title of "Krymsky".
